details.description: Godrej Nupur Henna, also known as Mehndi, is an exceptionally popular hair care solution renowned for its natural goodness and deep nourishing qualities. This 100% pure Rajasthani Henna product is a trusted companion for hair health and nourishment, blending tradition and innovation to provide a natural and nutritious alternative to hair colouring. Harnessing the potent conditioning benefits of henna, Godrej Nupur Henna Mehendi Hair Colour Powder offers a gorgeous reddish-brown tone and deep nourishment, enriched with the goodness of 6 herbs. Experience the elegance of this natural hair colourant and conditioner, which has been traditionally used for decorating hands and feet as a natural colourant. Godrej Nupur Henna is the pure, trusted solution for vibrant, healthy hair.
details.usageInstructions:
Soak Nupur Henna powder in water for 2-3 hours.
You may add curd/oil for extra softness.
Apply paste from root to tip of the hair.
Leave for 3-4 hours. Rinse thoroughly with water.
